title: Public distribution and first-use corrections
cause: First-use builds depend on private evidence and newly created device selections dirty the worktree; tracked and historical evidence contains private context.
introduction_cause: Internal development and publication workflows were combined.
escape_cause: Prior checks did not exercise a history-free distribution and clean first-use environment end to end.
deliverables: First-use build and device safety checks
dependencies: Retain internal gate and private evidence
Independent verification and physical application remain separate

investigation.hypothesis: The initial publication allowlist contains all files needed for an LCD firmware build.
investigation.evidence: Candidate v2 passed host and Rust checks but CMake configure rejected a missing diagnostics/backlight-polarity/main.c referenced by the existing LCD target.
investigation.correction: Include the required source and cover its presence in the export regression test.
investigation.pending: Repeat the actual firmware build and full candidate check using the corrected output.
investigation.verification: Corrected candidate v13 configured, built the normal LCD UF2 and passed offline preflight; no board was accessed.

investigation.hypothesis: The default all-target LCD build works with the documented unconnected-backlight sample.
investigation.evidence: Candidate v11 configured successfully but the diagnostic backlight target rejected the sample setting during an all-target build.
investigation.correction: The public build selects the main LCD or E-ink application target, leaving the existing optional diagnostic and internal gate unchanged.
investigation.pending: Repeat actual builds and preflight for the updated public route.
investigation.verification: Selecting the LCD application target built successfully with the documented unconnected-backlight sample; offline preflight passed. Final candidate must be rechecked.

investigation.hypothesis: The originally documented tool list is enough for the complete offline test suite.
investigation.evidence: The existing YouTube conversion tests invoke FFmpeg, FFprobe and nice, including an MPEG-4 encoder. The provenance adapter also requires a clean Git SDK and initialized submodules.
investigation.correction: Document these requirements and their checks in both setup guides.
investigation.pending: Verify on a new clean OS separately; the current isolated cache is not a clean OS.

investigation.hypothesis: Mandatory board identity and receipt-based admission are necessary for ordinary build and use.
investigation.evidence: The user explicitly requested removing the mandatory gates and physical-board identity checks for both authors and public users.
investigation.correction: Use ordinary build and UF2 copy while retaining compiler/SDK hardware and pin consistency checks.
investigation.pending: Verify the changed paths without touching hardware; keep the existing history private.
